panel.title: Rules
heroSection.heading: KUDOS RECIPIENTS: HERO BADGES FOR POSITIVE IMPACT
heroSection.description: Based on how many teammates have sent you Kudos, you'll earn the matching Hero badge, shown right next to your profile name
heroTier.new.label: New Hero
heroTier.new.description: The journey of spreading kindness begins — the first words of thanks and recognition have found you.
heroTier.rising.label: Rising Hero
heroTier.rising.description: You're steadily growing in your teammates' hearts through your kindness and dedication.
heroTier.super.label: Super Hero
heroTier.super.description: You've become a trusted and beloved figure — always ready to help, and remembered by many teammates.
heroTier.legend.label: Legend Hero
heroTier.legend.range: More than 20 people have sent you Kudos
heroTier.legend.description: You've become a legend — someone who left an unforgettable mark on the team through heart and action.
secretBox.heading: KUDOS SENDERS: COLLECT ALL 6 ICONS, GET A MYSTERY GIFT
secretBox.description: Every Kudos you send gets posted on the system and can earn ❤️ from the Sunner community. Every 5 ❤️, you get to open 1 Secret Box, with a chance to win one of 6 exclusive SAA icons.
secretBox.closingText: Sunners who collect the full set of 6 icons will receive a mystery gift from SAA 2025.
national.heading: NATIONAL KUDOS
national.description: The 5 Kudos with the most ❤️ across all of Sun* will officially become National Kudos and receive a special gift from SAA 2025: Root Further.
